adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent`, `selectedCalendar` is computed as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. In the else branch, `externalCalendarId` is falsy (null/undefined/""), so the `.find(...)` predicate compares against that falsy value and will not match normal destination calendars (whose `externalId` is a real string), yielding `undefined`. This is a real regression versus the previous fallback (`event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) and can result in `calendar.events.update` being called without a valid `calendarId` when references lack `externalCalendarId`.
